alignment.summary: Phase 1.1 re-alignment after the legacy plan migration. Covered nodes: Goal, Requirements (R1, R2), Acceptance Criteria (AC1, AC2), Notes, Alignment Decisions, open-nodes marker. Key decisions: (1) the legacy design.md/implement.md pair was migrated into a prescriptive plan.md and the prd.md gained only a migration note — R1/R2 and AC1/AC2 are carried over unchanged; (2) no product source file exists or is changed, so the verifiable surface is the task materials and the CASE artifacts; (3) AC2's runtime case is a deterministic local verification of the task artifacts because this fixture exposes no service socket, and coverage is declared not_applicable with a stated exclusion rather than fabricated; (4) case.md and case-result.md are authored by the check executor so designSession and checkSession are one session chain. User confirmation result: the task prompt explicitly authorizes migrate-then-design-then-confirm-then-execute, and the review above reports readyToConfirm=true with no structure issues, so the migration was confirmed and the alignment credential was re-recorded against the current prd hash.

case.summary: CASE for tasks/legacy-case reviewed and approved for execution. Design round: check executor session 01a1a4ec-eabd-70cb-bc87-37dd233664bf (purpose=case-design) authored case.md with SR1 and C1; workloom_task_case review returned readyToConfirm=true with zero structure issues.
